messages:
marta: Drafting the relnote for this week's docs rollout. Focus: embeddings streaming example updates + a short migration note about anchor normalization. PR #3401 up for review. Can someone sanity-check the Python and JS snippets? ping @ben @elaine :wave;
ben: Will do a quick SDK snippet pass. Noticed the JS sample still uses `.then()` style, we should switch to async iterators for streaming. I'll push a tiny change.
elaine: I'll review the Python snippet and the Known Issues blurb. Also noticed the docs anchor sanitizer is dropping query fragments — filed docs#1250.
sai: Reproduced the anchor issue on staging. Short-term: whitelist critical anchors in the publish pipeline. I can open a small PR for that (docs#1251).
marta: For the migration note, propose: "Published anchors may be normalized (query fragments removed). Update external links to use explicit fragments and validate after publish." Keep short.
ben: Pushed JS update to async iterator: ```js
for await (const part of client.streamEmbeddings({input: text})) {
  handle(part)
}
```
ben: Also changed a tiny var name to follow lint. `npm run lint` passes locally.
elaine: Python snippet updated to `RedwoodClient` ctor and added a one-line compatibility note: "When upgrading from older SDKs, replace Client(...) with RedwoodClient(...)".
docs-bot: Staging deploy scheduled 2024-07-31T02:00Z. Blockers: pending UX approval, 1 flaky link-check.
sai: Opened docs#1251 for anchor whitelist and added tests.
marta: Plan: merge after UX signoff and anchor smoke test. If anchors still break after publish we'll add a short rollback note and revert the relnote page only. Thanks all! :rocket;
elaine: LGTM on content. Leaving final approve once UX confirms visuals.
